name: Tennessee Technological University
tuition_note: In-state (TN resident) undergraduate tuition & fees $12,081 for 2025-26 and on-campus housing (room only) $7,014 for 2025-26 from tntech.edu/financialaid/cost.php cost of attendance page (food/board listed separately at $6,821, not included). 2026-27 figures also published ($12,685 tuition & fees; $7,365 housing).
